card.name: Digits inside phone and ISBN numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 0 or 1, in the middle of a phone number or ISBN. It fires most in toll-free numbers such as 800-5_0_3-0784.

modes.label: Phone number digit
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a phone number, often a toll-free 800 number.

modes.label: ISBN digit
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN in a citation.

card.plain: It notices a digit in the middle of a phone number or book number.
